annotations.title: Net salary: Romania vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in Romania (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many RON, for the euro amounts. Default 4.97 (indicative).

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in Romania, in RON

kids_in_school.description: Children are in education. Extra deduction of 100 RON a month per child enrolled in school. Default true.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in RON, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

name: compare_with_netherlands
title: Net salary: Romania vs the Netherlands
